LXPR13860.title: Dos Monitos Luxury Compound in Playa Grande
LXPR13860.description: Located just a short walk from Playa Grande’s iconic surf and golden shoreline, on the northern Pacific coast of Costa Rica, Dos Monitos is a private luxury compound spanning approximately 1.73 acres. The property consists of a striking six-bedroom main residence and three independent guest villas, each designed for privacy, modern living, and seamless integration with the natural surroundings. The main home offers luminous indoor-outdoor living with expansive terraces, open entertaining areas, and sweeping ocean views. Designed for both quiet retreat and hosting on a grand scale, it forms the heart of the estate. Across the landscaped grounds, three thoughtfully positioned guest villas provide additional space and flexibility. The first is a one-bedroom villa, ideal as an intimate and quiet hideaway. The second offers two bedrooms and is perfectly suited for friends or small families. The third is the largest, featuring three bedrooms, garden views, and a spacious, private layout, making it the most secluded of the three. In total, Dos Monitos features 12 bedrooms and 12.5 bathrooms across approximately 1,384 m² (14,900 sq ft) of construction, offering a rare combination of scale, design, and functionality. Additional amenities include multiple outdoor lounge areas, a gated entrance, caretaker’s casita, service quarters, and secure parking. Tucked away on the peaceful Calle Pots and Bowls, the estate lies within the protected Las Baulas Marine National Park, just minutes from tide pools, surf breaks, and the spectacular sunsets Playa Grande is known for. The natural setting is matched by the architectural vision of LSD Architecture, a renowned Costa Rican firm celebrated for its innovative tropical modernist style. Located on Costa Rica’s northern Pacific coast, Playa Grande is a surf and nature haven nestled between Langosta and Conchal, just across the estuary from Tamarindo. Playa Grande combines natural beauty with essential services, including a mid-size supermarket, medical clinic, and small shops, while Tamarindo, accessible by boat or a 30-minute drive, provides a vibrant mix of restaurants, nightlife, and boutiques. The area also offers easy access to outdoor adventures like zip lining, wildlife tours, and snorkeling. It’s conveniently reached via Liberia International Airport or Tamarindo’s local airstrip. Whether imagined as a multigenerational family estate, a high-end rental portfolio, or a wellness-focused retreat, Dos Monitos offers a level of privacy, flexibility, and design quality rarely found on Costa Rica’s Pacific c

LXGR14344.title: The Courtyard Home Nosara: Sanctuary Architecture Meets Jungle Luxury
LXGR14344.description: The Courtyard Home is a striking tropical sanctuary designed by Benjamín Saxe of Studio Saxe, where architecture opens effortlessly to gardens, jungle and sky. Two elegant pavilions unfold around a protected central courtyard, creating a home that feels both intimate and expansive. Mature trees rise alongside the architecture, floor-to-ceiling glass draws the landscape indoors, and open-air passages invite the breeze through spaces designed for relaxed tropical luxury. One pavilion forms the social heart of the home, with open living, dining and kitchen spaces flowing naturally outdoors, while the second provides greater privacy for the sleeping quarters. Studio Saxe’s bioclimatic approach is evident throughout, with thoughtful orientation, natural shade, cross-ventilation and quality materials responding to Nosara’s tropical climate. Outdoor living is integral to the design, with expansive built terraces extending around the pool and landscaped gardens. Generous spaces for lounging, dining, and entertaining are framed by raw tropical tranquility, creating a private retreat deeply connected to its surroundings. The Courtyard Home combines durable, low-maintenance design with proven rental performance, creating a compelling luxury asset in Nosara. Turnkey and well suited for on-site staffing, it offers the flexibility to perform as an income-producing property while remaining equally appealing as a private family retreat. Located in the gated hillside community of Las Huacas, just minutes from the surf at Playa Guiones and downtown Nosara, the home balances architectural distinction and privacy with the relaxed connection to nature that defines life here. Equally suited to everyday living or an exceptional tropical escape, The Courtyard Home offers a sophisticated expression of the Nosara lifestyle. Private viewings

LXER14024.title: Casa Satori in Cerro Real
LXER14024.description: Some homes reveal their essence instantly. Others, like Casa Satori, invite you to discover their depth gradually. This contemporary residence blends architecture, light, and silence to create a serene, deeply balanced living experience. From the moment you enter, defined volumes and double-height ceilings set the tone for a distinct spatial journey. The main level integrates the living and dining areas in a fluid layout, framed by floor-to-ceiling windows that fully open onto the terrace and pool. Outdoors, the design encourages different moments of connection: a fire pit that blends into the landscape, a terrace with a bar and grill ideal for entertaining, and a pool that transforms the garden into a private urban oasis. The kitchen is refined and understated, with dark tones, premium materials, a large central island, and smart storage solutions. It can open to or close off from the social areas with sliding doors, adapting effortlessly to the rhythm of the day. Like the rest of the house, the kitchen features a thoughtfully designed lighting system that enhances the home’s warm and sophisticated feel. On this level, there are two secondary bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom and walk-in closet. Between them, a cozy family room serves as a TV area. The home includes electric blinds, zoned climate control, and full smart-home integration for seamless everyday comfort. The upper floor is dedicated to rest and personal care. The primary suite enjoys wide west-facing views, a private balcony, a spacious walk-in closet, and a spa-style bathroom with soaking tub, cold plunge, sauna, and steam room, inviting daily rituals of recovery and relaxation. This level also includes a private office, a fitness room with full mirror and natural views, and a beauty salon that elevates the residential experience and transforms routine into wellness. The lower level houses the covered garage and service areas, keeping the home’s operations organized and discreet. Set in the prestigious gated community of Cerro Real, Casa Satori offers not only refined architecture, but also a lifestyle built around privacy, intention, and balance. The community features 24/7 security, a tennis court, rustic clubhouse, playground, and calm internal roads. Its ideal location offers quick access to Escazú, Santa Ana, and Route 27, as well as proximity to Multiplaza, Distrito 4, and top international schools like Blue Valley and Saint Mary. Casa Satori is a sanctuary of design and wellness for those who seek to live with purpos

LXGR14096.title: Casa Marbella : An Infinity -Edge Anthology at Hacienda Pinilla
LXGR14096.description: Casa Marbella Infinity is a 6,700 square foot coastal estate located in the Las Golondrinas gated community of Hacienda Pinilla in Guanacaste, Costa Rica. Set within one of the northern Pacific region’s most established beachfront communities, the residence offers architectural scale with immediate access to Playa Mansita through a private three-minute trail. Positioned within a 4,500-acre gated setting that includes golf, beach club amenities, and surf, the home offers a comprehensive coastal lifestyle. The architecture centers on volume, light, and seamless indoor-outdoor integration. Travertine marble floors extend beneath high ceilings, guiding the eye through walls of glass toward the infinity-edge pool that anchors the social areas. The pool reflects the sky and surrounding greenery, creating a visual focal point that connects the residence to its tropical setting. Manicured gardens and sun decks frame the home, offering both privacy and a living backdrop of native landscape. The kitchen features a central island that functions as a breakfast bar and preparation space. Expansive social salons open directly to the terrace and pool area, allowing entertaining to unfold naturally between interior and exterior environments. The 0.53-acre homesite provides proportion and breathing room, reinforcing the sense of a private sanctuary within a larger resort community. The layout includes seven bedrooms arranged to balance both scale and discretion. The second level is defined by two primary suites of equal presence, each opening to broad balconies that capture Pacific cross breezes. Five marble-clad bathrooms, soaking tubs, and a dedicated fitness and Nautilus suite support a wellness-oriented lifestyle within the privacy of the home. Ownership at Casa Marbella extends to the lifestyle offered by its community. Hacienda Pinilla encompasses 4,500 acres with access to three beaches, including Playa Mansita, as well as a beach club offering oceanfront dining and wellness amenities. The community features a championship golf course, tennis courts, equestrian trails, and extensive natural areas that support horseback riding, hiking, and cycling among local wildlife such as howler monkeys and iguanas. Located approximately one hour from Liberia International Airport and adjacent to the JW Marriott, the property benefits from both accessibility and established infrastructure within one of Costa Rica’s most recognized coastal

LXER13904.title: Extraordinary Mediterranean Hacienda at Jaboncillos
LXER13904.description:
Located within the area of Jaboncillos in Escazú, this single level residence offers a blend of classic architectural character and generous living spaces designed for both daily life and entertaining. Mediterranean Hacienda Residence is organized around a colonial style central courtyard with columns, arches, a beautiful water fountain and natural stone flooring, allowing natural light to move easily throughout the interior while maintaining privacy and a strong connection to the surrounding gardens. An eight meter tower ceiling at the entrance hall sets a sense of scale that carries throughout the home, complemented by open views.

Two double height living rooms with travertine floors create flexible gathering spaces that open toward a corner terrace and a larger main terrace finished in natural stone, surrounded by arches and romanesque columns, overlooking the city and surrounding mountains. Adjacent outdoor areas include a rancho with pizza oven and BBQ, offering a practical extension of the home for informal gatherings. The formal dining room features a beautifully handcrafted vaulted ceiling, while the kitchen is arranged with an island, pantry, breakfast bar, and an additional breakfast nook suited for everyday use. Finishes in almond wood and marble are used throughout, reinforcing the home’s consistent and understated architectural character.

Mediterranean Hacienda Residence’s private bedroom wing includes three en suite bedrooms. Two secondary bedrooms offer walk-in closets, while the primary suite includes a generous walk-in closet, full bathroom, private office, and its own terrace. Hardwood flooring enhances the sense of warmth and continuity throughout this section of the home.

The landscaped gardens surround a pool with jacuzzi, outdoor shower, and solar heating, creating a quiet outdoor setting for daily use. A separate guest house with a full bathroom is positioned near the pool area and includes a large mirror, making it suitable for exercise, yoga, or wellness activities. While the main residence is single level, the lower level accommodates a covered two vehicle garage, storage room, and the private office with a full bathroom, maintaining functionality without impacting the primary living areas.

Additional interior spaces include a TV room, laundry area with drying patio, full maid’s quarters, a private office with a full bathroom, and a guest bathroom. These areas are integrated into the layout without interrupting the flow of the main living spaces. Multiple storage rooms, a water tank, solar powered hot water system, and parking space for up to six vehicles are also part of this home.

Jaboncillos is a well established residential area set along the green hillsides of Escazú, known for its privacy, natural surroundings, and wide views of the Central Valley. The neighborhood offers a balance between accessibility and discretion, with convenient routes through Escazú, Santa Ana, and Guachipelín, as well as proximity to Route 27.

At the entrance to Jaboncillos, the La Paco lifestyle center provides dining, boutique retail, and a Fresh Market grocery. The broader Escazú and Guachipelín areas offer international schools, medical services, dining, and shopping, positioning Jaboncillos as a practical residential setting with a calm, residential atmosphere.

Mediterranean Hacienda Residence offers a well balanced combination of architectural character, functional living spaces, and outdoor areas in one of Escazú’s most established residential

LXER14095.title: Timeless Mediterranean Residence in Lindora
LXER14095.description: In Lindora, Santa Ana, this Mediterranean inspired villa by renowned architect Federico Castro offers timeless detailing and an easy connection between indoor and outdoor living. The home is defined by graceful arches, exposed wood beams, soaring ceilings, and expansive terraces on both levels. Located on the western side of the Central Valley of Costa Rica, natural materials carry throughout, including marble floors and solid wood finishes that bring warmth and a sense of permanence to the interiors. The main level was conceived with entertaining in mind. Entry through double doors leads to a welcoming foyer with access to the second floor and the principal social areas. A generous living room and dining room sit on either side and connect through a central square arch, creating a layout that reads as open while still feeling composed. From the social spaces, doors open to the outdoors, anchored by a main covered terrace that opens through a series of arches to the garden and pool. The pool is framed by clean stone decking and a broad lawn that keeps the setting open and usable, while tall green walls and natural stonework add privacy and texture around the perimeter. Just beyond the main terrace, an independent terrace area creates a second destination for entertaining, centered around a sophisticated firepit and set apart enough to feel like its own outdoor room for evening conversation. A dedicated bar room, also accessed from the terrace, adds a distinct hosting space with dark countertops, ample room to gather, and glass windows that keep the connection to the outdoors present throughout the day and evening. At the heart of the home, a spacious kitchen is anchored by an oversized island for cooking and informal meals. A cozy family niche at the end of the island becomes the natural everyday meeting point, balancing the home’s formal entertaining scale with daily livability. Additional functional spaces include a private office and a dedicated gym area surrounded by large windows. Upstairs, four bedrooms are found, including two impressive primary suites designed as private retreats. Each bedroom offers its own character, with lots of details, access to terraces or Juliet balconies in some, a jacuzzi tub in one bathroom, and large windows that bring in abundant natural light. In total, the residence includes 5.5 bathrooms finished with timeless materials and elegant detailing. Lindora, located in the western Central Valley within Santa Ana, is recognized for its upscale residential setting and strong day-to-day convenience. The area offers access to Route 27 for connections to Escazú, downtown San José, and the Pacific Coast, with nearby routes that also link to Belén, Alajuela, and Guachipelín. Shopping and lifestyle options include Terrazas de Lindora and Momentum Lindora, along with gourmet supermarkets such as Automercado, Fresh Market, and Vindi, and the area is near international schools including Pan American School and Saint Jude School. The result is a residence distinguished by architectural presence, generous proportions, and enduring Mediterranean character, offering a complete lifestyle setting with spaces that support both refined entertaining and everyday rhythm in one of Santa Ana’s most desirable r

LXSR12574.title: Villa Unika Beachfront in Malpaís
LXSR12574.description: Beachfront privacy in Malpaís nature. Villa Unika in Malpaís is a mystic two-level beachfront luxury residence with six bedrooms, a spacious indoor and outdoor social area and a refreshing style that blends natural light with a cool ocean breeze. The house opens through multiple sets of louvered doors to the garden and the terrace area, offering a sun deck and a delightful swimming pool. The property is very private and enjoys a beachfront location in Malpaís, a small and private beach in Cóbano, known for its scenic beauty and proximity to the surf town of Santa Teresa. A white pebbled driveway welcomes you to Villa Unika in Malpaís, mango trees and tropical plants setting the refreshing ambience of the house. Wood doors greet you to the foyer, framed by an indoor garden. The social area boasts an ample distribution featuring fully integrated areas, including living and dining rooms equipped with ceiling fans. Unique Beachfront’s kitchen revolves around a central and ample gas kitchen counter with enough space for a breakfast area. The social area opens through several sets of louvered doors to the terrace and garden areas, incorporating natural light and cross ventilation inside. Perfect for Malpaís’ sunny weather, Villa Unika’s swimming pool offers a sun tanning area and a covered rancho with hammocks beside a wood deck. White pebbles and trees that provide shade create an additional lounge area in front of the bedrooms. The surrounding garden offers a completely flat area with palm trees and a direct path to the beach. As you make your way to the private area, five secondary bedrooms are offered. They boast high ceilings that provide great air flow and wood ceilings with a fan each. Three of them have their own ensuite bathrooms and the remaining two share one with two sinks and two showers. The private bedrooms open through louvered doors to the terrace, a feature that also makes them well-ventilated. Back in the foyer, a staircase welcomes guests to a living room with expansive windows and louvered doors that open to a balcony above the swimming pool and with ocean views. This space is fully integrated to a bedroom, featuring vaulted ceilings, with fans and its own bathroom. The latter includes an open distribution with great privacy, a jacuzzi and two showers. Villa Unika is equipped with a 27,000-liter underground water tank, an artisan well and is connected to the municipal water system. The house includes independent storage and laundry areas, and additional storage space in a 20 feet container. Approved permits offer the possibility of building three bungalows for a total of 510m2. A sanctuary for relaxation and introspection, this majestic property in Malpaís boasts unmatched privacy, a peaceful ambience and a unique design perfect for entertainment. Malpaís is less frequented than Santa Teresa, a small, beautiful bay beach with tide pools. The neighboring town of Santa Teresa boasts international cuisine, a vibrant community and great surf spots, less than 10 min

LXER13808.title: Casa Meerwald @ Faro Escondido
LXER13808.description: High above Costa Rica’s Pacific coast, in the exclusive enclave of Faro Escondido, stands Casa Meerwald, an architectural masterpiece envisioned by Saxe Studio, celebrated for harmonizing contemporary design with the essence of the natural world. With 1,400 square meters of living space, Casa Meerwald redefines the concept of home as an architectural sanctuary, where art, nature, and sophistication coexist in perfect harmony. From its privileged perch overlooking the Bay of Herradura, every room opens to sweeping ocean views that capture the beauty and tranquility of the Pacific. Upon entering, a sculptural floating staircase wraps around an indoor garden, forming the poetic heart of the residence, a serene space where light, air, and greenery intertwine to create a living, breathing atmosphere. On the main level, the social area extends toward a spectacular infinity-edge pool, a water mirror terrace, and a fire pit, setting the stage for starlit evenings and quiet coastal moments. On the opposite side, lush green landscaping evokes the feeling of a private forest retreat. A multifunctional studio completes this level, ideal as a home office, fitness area, creative atelier, or even a fifth bedroom, adding versatility to the home’s elegant design. The upper level is dedicated to rest and privacy, featuring a family TV lounge and four full bedrooms, each with its own private terrace that celebrates seamless indoor-outdoor living. Every corner reflects the philosophy of Saxe Studio: spaces conceived to be shared, with bioclimatic pergolas and natural ventilation systems that embody both sustainability and sophistication. Living here means enjoying the exclusive integration with Los Sueños Resort & Marina, where residents have access to a championship golf course, private marina, spa, and beach club. Within Faro Escondido, owners also enjoy the community’s own clubhouse, tennis court, and private beach reserved solely for residents. The location is exceptional: just one hour from San José, and minutes from Jacó and Playa Hermosa, world-famous destinations for surfing, sportfishing, and the vibrant coastal lifestyle of Costa Rica’s Pacific. Faro Escondido is a secure, consolidated, and high-value community, where each home is a true architectural treasure. Casa Meerwald is an iconic property, an architectural legacy that unites design, nature, and exclusivity in a single, immersive experience. A home that feels alive, inspires, and belongs among the rare few th

LXPR13368.title: Atrium House: 360° Panoramic Views Where Forest Canopy Meets the Ocean
LXPR13368.description: Atrium House is a 756 m² architectural residence in Las Huacas, Nosara, Guanacaste, Costa Rica, designed by Benjamin Saxe of Studio Saxe around 360° panoramic views encompassing the Pacific Ocean and surrounding forest canopy. Set high along the ridge line above Playa Guiones, the home combines multi level indoor and outdoor living, a central passive cooling atrium, private pool, custom interiors, and preserved mature trees within a distinctive hillside design. Rather than imposing a conventional structure on its setting, Atrium House was integrated into the hilltop and positioned around mature trees to preserve the existing canopy. The architecture responds directly to the landscape, creating a close relationship between the residence, tropical vegetation, and broad ocean outlooks. At the center is the namesake atrium, a dramatic vertical space designed to serve both architectural and practical purposes. Ocean breezes are drawn upward through the structure, naturally regulating temperature and reducing energy dependency. This passive approach complements the home’s open living spaces and connection to the outdoors. The upper level social area floats above the tree line, opening the residence to sunset views across the Pacific and Playa Guiones while maintaining privacy. An open floor plan is complemented by custom furniture, tailored millwork, and curated art pieces. On the ground level, a second social space connects directly with the private pool, built in outdoor lounge, BBQ area, and surrounding tropical greenery. Atrium House sits alongside a local wildlife corridor, bringing sightings of howler monkeys, toucans, and native birds into the everyday experience of the property. Playa Guiones and the downtown area are approximately 3 to 4 kilometers away, with a drive of about five minutes. Defined by a sophisticated palette of natural stone, rich wood, custom millwork, and carefully curated finishes, Atrium House balances warmth and understated glamour with the relaxed elegance of coastal living. Each material has been deliberately selected to elevate the architectural experience and, as with any refined coastal residence, benefits from attentive care to preserve its beauty and character over time. Atrium House is offered turnkey and can serve as either a private estate or an income generating property within the Nosara luxury market, with private viewings arranged by appointment. Atrium House brings architecture, forest canopy, and panoramic Pacific views together in Las Huacas,

LXER12675.title: Designers Dream Home @ Villa Real
LXER12675.description: Elegance, mountain views and impeccable attention to detail. Designer’s Dream is a two-level luxury home featuring a unique style in Villa Real, on the coveted west side of San José, Costa Rica. Ample areas perfect for entertainment, carefully selected finishes and thoughtful design combine to create an elegant and refreshing home with plenty of natural light and ventilation. The home enjoys stunning mountain views to the east and south of the city amidst the lush green areas of Villa Real, the exclusive community strategically located between Escazú and Santa Ana. Cobbled streets guide to the Designer Dream Home entrance. A U-shaped driveway surrounded by manicured gardens with tall palm trees introduce the modern architecture with clean lines, high ceilings and perfectly balanced black and white contrasts. The large main door welcomes opens onto an ample, open space with double-height ceilings and marble floors imported from Italy, credit to the renowned interior designer Ileana Palacios. Beautiful mountain and garden views from the terrace imbue the entire social area with a refreshing air. Designer Dream Home’s main living area is integrated with the dining area, both offering spacious areas radiating white elegance and equipped with low energy consumption air conditioning. Next to the dining area, glass sliding doors open to the climate-controlled wine room, boasting two walls for wines, a round central table and a beautiful Baccarat lamp. The guest bathroom boasts onyx detailing imported from Brazil. The living room also extends to the kitchen and family TV areas. The Designer Dream Home Kitchen boasts black panels with white furniture and countertops, creating an elegant and inviting design. The main central counter offers plenty of preparation space, a sink and a Milton kitchen. The black panels hide Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances and, like the rest of the home, the kitchen is equipped with Lutron and Sonos smart lighting and sound systems. Both the TV room and kitchen areas open through a set of glass sliding doors to the terrace, boasting a decked floor with an open yet covered distribution with transparent roof that adds natural illumination. Perfect for weekend BBQ’s and celebrations, this area connects to the patio, a flat space with landscaped gardens and clear mountain views. One of Designer’s Dream most unique features is its private area on the first floor. The master suite offers a spacious area with double-height ceilings, electric curtains and sliding glass doors that open to the garden, incorporating natural ventilation. The master ensuite bathroom offers a bathtub and continues the elegant style with black and white blends. Two secondary bedrooms are also offered on the first floor, each with walk-in closet, air conditioning and double-height ceilings, and private bathroom. Back near the wine area, a black staircase with glass railing and steel detailing guides guests to the upper floor, where an office or fourth bedroom is included. It has a walk-in closet, bathroom and views to the east of the city. By being the only room in the upper floor it has plenty of privacy. Designer’s Dream Home offers a two-car garage and outside space for several more. Near the garage, a multi-purpose room is offered, ideal for a gym, movie theater or an office, with the advantage of having an additional entrance outside the house. The laundry area connects to a secondary kitchen with black quartz countertops. Villa Real is an exclusive community known for its cobbled streets and wide array of amenities. The social area offers a BBQ clubhouse beside a kid’s playground and a lap pool. A covered tennis court, turf soccer field and a basketball court are distributed nearby. For more formal occasions, an indoor social area is available for celebrations or any other event. Villa Real is equipped with triple-level security, hiking trails and a direct access to Route 27, minutes away from the top-quality schools, services, and restaurants Escazú a

LXER12982.title: Lumina Terrace @ Solaris
LXER12982.description:
The only apartment available in Solaris with a private terrace of this amazing scale, Lumina Terrace is exactly as extraordinary as it sounds. Set in the mountains between Escazú and Santa Ana, Costa Rica, this singular residence brings together privacy, volume, open air living, and unobstructed views across the Central Valley, all within one of the west side of San José’s most exclusive residential communities.

Designed to blur the line between interior comfort and life under the open sky, the residence moves with ease from one space to the next. A generous living area, a dedicated media lounge, and a show stopping double island kitchen create a home that feels both polished and highly livable. The kitchen is finished in stone and precision cabinetry, fully equipped with a complete suite of brand new KitchenAid appliances, and designed for the kind of daily rhythm where cooking becomes part of the experience.

Floor to ceiling windows frame the Central Valley and surrounding mountains from every room, filling the interiors with natural light and keeping the landscape in constant view. The private terrace is the defining feature of Lumina Terrace, oversized, covered, and entirely your own. With translucid glass railings that soften the boundary between apartment and valley, it is a space made for quiet mornings, long evenings, and entertaining without losing the sense of privacy that makes the residence so distinctive.

The bedroom layout continues the same sense of ease and intention. Each of the three bedrooms includes a private ensuite bathroom and panoramic views, giving every room its own sense of retreat. The primary suite is especially composed, with wide plank oak floors, a spa level bathroom, double vanity, freestanding soaking tub facing the valley, rain shower, and matte black hardware.

Three underground parking spaces and a dedicated storage room add convenience without interrupting the elegance of the home. Solaris itself adds another layer to the experience, with a rooftop, movie theater, recreational pool, semi Olympic pool, two tennis courts, gym, spa, sauna, steam room, business center, and organic garden.

The location places Lumina Terrace in the mountains between Escazú and Santa Ana, on the west side of San José, Costa Rica. It is a setting that connects the privacy and elevation of mountain living with access to two of the capital region’s most established lifestyle areas, giving the residence a strong sense of place without feeling removed from the city’s daily conveniences.

Lumina Terrace at Solaris is not simply defined by its terrace, its views, or its scale. It is a residence shaped by the feeling of living above the valley, with room to breathe, room to gather, and a level of privacy that makes everyday life feel distinctly elevated in Escazú and Santa Ana

LXER10658.title: Casa Luna - Hacienda Pinilla
LXER10658.description: Casa Luna is a refined Neo-Colonial residence located within the sought-after community of Hacienda Pinilla, Reserva de Golf, near Avellanas Beach known for its soft white sand and turquoise waters. Designed with a thoughtful balance of comfort and tropical sophistication, this home blends local materials and timeless craftsmanship to create a serene and welcoming atmosphere. Throughout the interiors, rich native woods, brick details, and artistic mosaic floors bring warmth and texture, while the open concept layout and double height ceilings enhance the sense of space and natural light. The living and dining areas connect effortlessly with the terrace and pool through elegant wood-framed sliding doors, creating a seamless indoor–outdoor lifestyle ideal for entertaining or quiet relaxation. Each bedroom has been designed as a private retreat, filled with natural light and surrounded by tranquil garden views. The main suites include marble-finished bathrooms with jacuzzi tubs and intimate internal patios, a true expression of comfort and coastal luxury. Casa Luna is set within Hacienda Pinilla, a 4,500-acre gated community that celebrates Costa Rica’s natural beauty and heritage. Residents enjoy access to a signature golf course, tennis courts, equestrian trails, a beach club, and several fine dining options. With much of the land preserved as forest and pasture, wildlife sightings, including howler monkeys and tropical birds are part of daily life. This is a setting where elegance meets authenticity, and the essence of the Guanacaste coast unfolds right at your d

LXER14202.title: Casa Paraiso del Trópico in Turrúcares
LXER14202.description: Casa Paraiso del Trópico is an architecturally significant estate in Turrúcares, Costa Rica, offering a rare combination of privacy, natural beauty, and thoughtfully designed living spaces. Set within approximately 7,000 m² of lush grounds, the property features mature gardens, a picturesque creek, expansive social areas, a guest house, and exceptional outdoor amenities, creating an environment that feels both refined and deeply connected to nature. Located within an exclusive estate community in Turrúcares, the property enjoys a setting that has become increasingly sought after by those who value tranquility while maintaining convenient access to key destinations throughout Costa Rica. Its proximity to Juan Santamaría International Airport and Route 27 allows for efficient connections to Escazú, Santa Ana, the Pacific Coast, and major business centers. Designed by acclaimed architect Katia Marten, the main residence showcases timeless architectural principles, generous proportions, and quality finishes throughout. From the moment of arrival, the property makes a lasting impression with its spacious covered parking area, extensive additional parking, and elegant entrance framed by columns and solid wood details. The main social areas are defined by coffered ceilings, exposed wood beams, and expansive windows that frame the surrounding gardens. The living and dining spaces flow naturally toward a large terrace, creating a seamless relationship between the interior and the outdoors. The kitchen serves as a central gathering space, featuring a substantial island, luxury granite countertops, and abundant room for entertaining. The private wing of the home includes a television lounge, office, guest powder room, and an impressive primary suite designed to fully embrace the surrounding natural views. The suite features large windows, a spacious walk-in closet, and an en suite bathroom with dual vanities. Additional functional spaces include a laundry area, storage room, and service quarters. The residence also includes the necessary provisions for a future elevator installation. A striking staircase crafted from almond wood planks leads to the upper level, where a second family room and two spacious bedroom suites provide comfortable accommodations, each with its own private bathroom. Outdoor living is equally compelling. The pool area is complemented by a fully equipped BBQ rancho, bathroom, changing area, and an additional bedroom or multipurpose room that can adapt to a variety of needs. An independent guest house with a living room, kitchen, two bedrooms, and a bathroom further enhances the property’s flexibility and privacy. Casa Paraiso del Trópico brings together architecture, nature, and privacy in a distinctive residential offering within Turrú

LXCR14270.title: Golden Hour Home @ Bosques de Altamonte
LXCR14270.description: Contemporary residence in the renowned Bosques de Altamonte, Curridabat, on the east side of San José. Designed around natural light, generous ceiling heights and a close relationship with the garden and surrounding views, the home combines stone, wood and concrete with expansive windows and carefully integrated social spaces. Its architecture creates a warm sense of openness from the moment you enter, while the different levels give each part of the residence a distinct purpose. Designed by architect Franco Casalvolone, the home introduces its architectural language through double height spaces, high ceilings and broad areas of glass. The living and dining rooms share an open social setting with detailed ceilings, niches and integrated lighting. Both connect directly with the terrace and garden, while strategically positioned plants and shrubs are framed through the windows and become part of the interior experience. A guest bathroom features a stone wall, lighting and a window facing the landscape, and a spacious office with built-in furnishings is also located on this level. The independent kitchen remains closely connected to the social areas, terrace and garden. Generous windows bring in natural light and open the room toward views of the Central Valley, while a central island creates an inviting place for everyday gathering. LXER14144.title: Into the Green Santa Ana Home

Into the Green in Santa Ana, on the western side of the Central Valley of Costa Rica, belongs to the second category, five en suite bedrooms, resort style outdoor living, a heated pool, a private landscaped garden, and interiors designed with a level of detail that feels both sophisticated and livable. The facade introduces the tone with travertine, dark wood details, and curated greenery. The architecture does not need to announce itself loudly. It reveals its quality through proportion, material, and flow. The main living room is generous, bright, and directly connected to the garden and pool through double doors. Large format contemporary art, perimeter indirect lighting, and polished marble floors create a setting that feels intimate while still carrying presence. Nearby, the dining room becomes one of the home’s strongest moments, with a sculptural arrangement of black and gold pendant lights above a glass table for twelve. A backlit glass door wine cellar displays the collection with the feeling of an art installation, while the living area and garden are framed beyond. The kitchen is fully equipped for serious cooking and designed to remain visually composed. Wolf and Sub Zero appliances are paneled into the cabinetry, paired with Veneta Cucine cabinets, an onyx central table surface, quartz counters, gas cooking, Grohe fixtures, and a walk-in pantry. It is a kitchen built for function, but finished with restraint. The covered terrace is where the home truly opens up. Open on three sides, with a coffered ceiling and perimeter indirect lighting, it integrates a complete outdoor kitchen with Wolf grill, professional extractor, sink, exterior television, and a dining table for ten. From here, the view extends across the heated pool with night lighting, fire torches, the mature tree that gives scale to the lot, and the hedges that shape a strong sense of privacy. A second covered lounge completes the outdoor circuit. The master bath is one of the defining spaces of the residence. A full wall of backlit blue agate slices becomes mural, sculpture, and light source at once. Opposite it, a sculptural freestanding bathtub anchors the room, accompanied by a double marble vanity, warm wood cabinetry, and a shower with green garden views as its backdrop. The master suite also has direct pool views, garden access, wood floors, walk-in closet, and ceilings with indirect lighting. Set in Santa Ana, one of the fastest growing areas on the western side of San José, Into the Green offers a setting that combines established residential privacy with immediate access to business, dining, schools, and everyday conveniences. The area is known for its temperate climate, with access through Route 27 near Pozos or the old road from Escazú, placing Lindora, City Place, Automercado, Container Platz, Town Center Santa Ana, United World College, and the local farmers market within the broader Santa Ana lifestyle. Its prime walkable location in central Santa Teresa is one of the clearest drivers of guest appeal and occupancy in the area, while the combination of a four bedroom home and a separate two bedroom guesthouse allows for multiple rental configurations that can help maximize income. The layout is especially well suited for buyers who want to enjoy one residence while renting the other, and its mix of home sizes responds well to demand from both family groups and guests seeking a two bedroom stay. Designed for privacy, functionality, and ease of use, the property includes parking for two cars plus an ATV, motorbike, or bicycles, along with lush tropical landscaping that gives the compound a calm and inviting feel. It is also turnkey and rental ready, adding immediate value for buyers who want a property that can serve both lifestyle and investment goals from the outset. Santa Teresa is part of the beach and tourism corridor of the southern Nicoya Peninsula, an area recognized by official tourism channels for its natural beach setting and by local district authorities as one of the principal coastal communities within Cóbano. That broader context helps explain the strength of a walkable central location close to the beach, surf, restaurants, and shops. For a buyer looking for a Costa Rica property that combines lifestyle value, practical flexibility, and strong rental potential, this offering is particular

LXSR13699.title: Casa Brisas at Montezuma
LXSR13699.description: This two-bedroom, fully furnished residence offers a comfortable balance of privacy and convenience in one of the Nicoya Peninsula’s most desirable coastal settings. Located just minutes from the beaches of Montezuma and within easy reach of Futuro Verde, the area’s International Baccalaureate school, the property is also only 12 minutes from the new Cobano airport, an ideal combination for those seeking connectivity without compromising on tranquility. The home’s 200 square meters are designed with functionality in mind. An open living room welcomes natural light and breezes, creating an inviting atmosphere complemented by a dedicated TV room. The kitchen is fully equipped and designed to flow seamlessly into the living spaces, making both everyday living and entertaining effortless. Beyond the main living areas, the property features a two story annex, offering flexible use as a home office, gym, or guest quarters. A deck above the annex provides the possibility for expansion, whether as an additional bedroom or an outdoor lounge with views over the gardens. Outdoors, the setting is equally appealing. A large swimming pool anchors the landscaped gardens, where a variety of fruit trees provide seasonal harvests and a connection to the land. The garden setting is enhanced by a small yet captivating ocean view, a reminder of the coastline just minutes away. Covered parking and ample storage add to the home’s practicality. Set within a low density gated community, the property offers both privacy and security. A private well ensures water independence, with the option of public water connection available for added flexibility. Whether as a primary residence or a vacation retreat, this home offers an easy, well-rounded lifestyle; where nature, community, and modern comforts meet on Costa Rica’s enchanting Nicoya

LXPR13875.title: Caña Dulce Home Modern & Conscious Living in Playa Negra
LXPR13875.description: Enjoy natural beach living within the Rancho Agua Dulce residential and equestrian community in Playa Negra, Guanacaste. Set for completion in March 2026, Casa Caña Dulce presents a rare design-forward, eco-conscious residence before its unveiling. Located within the serene Rancho Agua Dulce, just minutes from Playa Negra on Costa Rica’s Pacific coast and close to Avellanas, Playa Blanca, and Junquillal, this property blends modern architecture, natural textures, and environmental intention. Designed by Octavio Van Praag, founder of Praag Architecture Studio, the home reflects a thoughtful approach to space and materials. The residence offers approximately 205 square meters (2,206 square feet) of interior living space, with three bedrooms and three bathrooms arranged around an elegant interior courtyard that enhances natural light, airflow, and privacy. The architecture incorporates handcrafted bamboo ceilings, stone cladding, and clay tile flooring to deliver both aesthetic refinement and passive cooling. Set on a generous 5,500 square meter (1.36-acre) lot, the home opens to expansive terraces and a saltwater pool designed to minimize water use and reduce chlorine dependency. The open-concept kitchen and living areas flow effortlessly to the outdoors, inviting constant interaction with the surrounding nature and creating a calming atmosphere for daily living. Sustainability is integral to every element of the design, from locally sourced materials to passive cooling systems that ensure year-round comfort with minimal environmental impact. Permits for an additional home are included, offering added flexibility for future expansion or investment. To further enhance the home’s organic elegance, curated custom furniture packages are available starting at $40,000, allowing homeowners to personalize the space with pieces that reflect their individuality. Playa Negra in Guanacaste is a laid-back coastal village known for its consistent surf, natural beauty, and year-round sunshine. Surrounded by tropical dry forest and rich wildlife—including monkeys, sea turtles, and diverse birdlife—it offers a peaceful setting for nature lovers and surfers alike. The area combines rustic charm with growing local amenities, all while maintaining its relaxed, off-the-beaten-path appeal. Casa Caña Dulce is an expression of balance, combining craftsmanship with a deep respect for the land. It’s an ideal sanctuary for those seeking an intentional lifestyle in one of Guanacaste’s most authentic coastal area

LXPR13877.title: Exquisite Caribbean Style Surf House Playa Grande
LXPR13877.description: Located in one of the most private sections of Las Ventanas de Playa Grande, Casa Surf offers Caribbean-inspired architecture on the renowned northern Pacific coast of Costa Rica. Just a short drive or bike ride from Playa Grande’s iconic surf breaks, this single-level home is found in a peaceful corner of the gated community, surrounded by mature landscaping and complete privacy. With thoughtful details, a fluid indoor-outdoor layout, and no immediate neighbors, Casa Surf stands out as a rare retreat that feels both connected and secluded. Built in 2019, Casa Surf features approximately 160 m² (1,722 sq ft) of living space, designed to embrace natural light. High ceilings and expansive windows define the interior, while glass sliding doors in both the living room and kitchen open directly onto a large terrace and sparkling pool. The kitchen offers soft grey cabinetry, quality finishes, and a two-level island that serves both as a prep space and a casual dining area. Each of the three bedrooms offers generous space and peaceful views of the surrounding garden. The home sits on a beautifully landscaped 2,004 m² (0.43-acre) lot, bordered by greenery and without immediate neighbors, offering rare privacy this close to the beach. The outdoor space includes a large terrace for dining and lounging, a private pool, and lush plantings that create a tranquil, resort-like atmosphere. As part of Las Ventanas de Playa Grande, homeowners enjoy 24/7 security, paved roads, and amenities like hiking trails, a skate park, and multi-use sport courts. Whether you're looking for a permanent residence, vacation getaway, or investment with rental appeal, Casa Surf is a versatile and inviting choice on the vibrant northern Pacific coast of Costa Rica.

LXPL13961.title: Oceanfront Legacy Land Between Avellanas & Playa Negra
LXPL13961.description: Set along a quiet stretch of Playa Lagartillo, this titled beachfront property offers a unique opportunity to build in one of Guanacaste’s most naturally beautiful and exclusive coastal areas. Positioned between the sought-after destinations of Playa Avellanas and Playa Negra, and just 20 minutes from Tamarindo, the location offers both seclusion and access to amenities. The property spans 3,693 m² (≈ 0.91 acres) of flat, build-ready land with a renewed 20-year concession title, making it ready for immediate development. With direct beach access and wide turquoise ocean views, it’s well-suited for a private luxury home, boutique hospitality concept, or strategic investment project. Playa Lagartillo is known for its quiet atmosphere, clean shoreline, and low-density surroundings, making it a favorite for those looking to build in harmony with the landscape. The property is just minutes from world-class surf, golf at Hacienda Pinilla, and some of the region’s best restaurants and wellness centers. Tucked into a peaceful corner of the coast, the property offers a rare sense of seclusion while remaining close to key destinations. Just minutes from Playa Avellanas and the amenities of Hacienda Pinilla, it strikes a balance between privacy and proximity. Tamarindo’s restaurants, nightlife, and boutique shops are only 20 minutes away, and Liberia International Airport (LIR) is just an hour’s drive, making the property easily accessible for international visitors and residents alike. A custom wood door separates the social areas from the private wing, where a cozy TV room connects three secondary bedrooms and an office that’s ideal for remote work or creative pursuits. All rooms enjoy access to the surrounding garden through sliding doors, creating a strong indoor-outdoor connection. The primary suite features high ceilings, a spacious bathroom with a double vanity and dual shower, and a large walk-in closet. The home includes four full bathrooms, air conditioning in every space, a laundry area, a drying patio, service quarters, and a mezzanine ideal for storage. As part of the Hacienda del Sol community, Solara benefits from 24/7 security, wide green spaces, and top-tier amenities including a clubhouse, tennis court, gym, and swimming pool—all fostering a balanced, active lifestyle in a peaceful setting. It remains just minutes from top-rated international schools, gourmet restaurants in Lindora, and shopping in Multiplaza Escazú. LXSL14026.title: Oceanview Development Opportunity in Santiago
LXSL14026.description: Located in Santiago, just minutes from Santa Teresa and Malpaís, this expansive landholding offers a rare opportunity to develop at scale in one of the Nicoya Peninsula’s most sought after growth corridors. The property spans just over three hectares and is well positioned for a wide range of residential or hospitality concepts. The land already includes multiple segregated lots, with additional subdivisions currently in progress through the municipality. This structure allows for flexibility in planning, whether the vision involves phased development, a cohesive community concept, or individual lot sales over time. Zoning permits a construction footprint of up to 75 percent, creating strong development potential without the limitations typically associated with beachfront properties. The site is well suited for a boutique hotel, wellness retreat, residential enclave, or a thoughtfully designed mixed use project. Set above the coastline, the property enjoys sweeping ocean views complemented by lush jungle and mountain scenery. The elevated position provides natural airflow, open sightlines, and consistent sunsets, enhancing both livability and long term value. Despite its sense of privacy and connection to nature, the land remains close to Santa Teresa’s surf breaks, dining scene, and everyday amenities. This balance of scale, views, and proximity makes the property especially attractive to developers and investors seeking opportunity in a maturing yet still dynamic market. LXCL14348.title: The One Lot el Gregal
LXCL14348.description:

LXHR13712.title: Lumina Home @ Cariari

Known for its lush landscapes, quiet ambiance, and easy access to key business and commercial zones like Lindora and Belén, it remains one of the most established and desirable neighborhoods for luxury living. Full-height glass walls bathe the space in natural light and open completely to the garden, creating a seamless flow for entertaining and daily living. A delicately shaped fountain greets you to the main entrance, surrounded by several round Roman columns with palm trees that highlight the home’s ever-present elegance and symmetry. Up three marble stairs, two large wooden doors open onto the main foyer. The entrance to The Cariari Collection Estate offers double height-ceilings, a grand staircase, and refreshing ambience due to the natural light and visible indoor garden. From here and to the left, a brief hall connects to the formal dining room also conveniently connected to the kitchen. The garden view and cross-ventilation create a fresh feel. A bay window in the social area boasts stone detailing and beautiful garden views, ideal for drinking tea or coffee.
